messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: stretched projective orbit of a finite reflection group

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Take the orbit of a generic interior point under the affine Weyl group of type Ã₂, realized as the affine map sending the fundamental alcine triangle to a triangle with vertices (0,0), (1,0), (0,1); choosing the interior point so that the 13 orbit points (reduced modulo the unit square lattice) are distinct, the bottleneck triangle area is maximized when the point's barycentric coordinates are (3/13, 4/13, 6/13), yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/156. This is the unique optimum within the stretched projective orbit, and it beats any configuration arising from a finite (non-affine) reflection group orbit by at least a factor of 2."}
